name: King
description: The ruling king of a kingdom. A royal NPC at the head of the realm.

name: Queen
description: The ruling queen of a kingdom. A royal NPC at the head of the realm.

name: Prince
description: A prince of the realm. A royal NPC of the ruling house.

name: Princess
description: A princess of the realm. A royal NPC of the ruling house.

name: High Priest / High Priestess
description: The highest faith leader of the kingdom. Guides worship and sacred work.

name: Priest / Priestess
description: A faith servant of the kingdom. Tends rites, shrines, and the needs of the devout.

name: General
description: The military commander of the kingdom. Directs forces and defense.

name: King's Guard
description: An elite guard sworn to protect the crown and the royal household.

name: Guard
description: A kingdom guard. Watches gates, walls, and the order of the settlement.

name: Archer
description: A ranged fighter of the kingdom. Trained with the bow.

name: Mage
description: A spellcaster of the kingdom. Brings magic into battle and study.

name: Blacksmith
description: A metalworker of the kingdom. Forges tools, weapons, and armor.

name: Tailor
description: A clothworker of the kingdom. Cuts and sews garments and cloth goods.

name: Alchemist
description: A potion-maker of the kingdom. Brews reagents, tonics, and other alchemical work.

name: Peasant
description: A common villager of the kingdom. Lives and works on the land under your reign.
